scope: Distinct physical trophy designs in officially released or licensed Predator/AVP media through 2026.
inclusionRule: Screen objects, persistent physical game collectibles/galleries, named licensed cosmetics and clearly labelled licensed accessories.
exclusionRule: Kills, claims, counters, honor mechanics, platform achievements, living captives and unretained field remains are census-only.
namingRule: Unnamed species remain descriptive and anonymous; medium and continuity status are always visible.
